---
applyTo: "docs/**/*.md,*.md"
---

# Documentation Instructions

- Keep docs concise and concrete.
- Mention routing, scoped tools, permissions, structured outputs, and traceability when documenting runtime behavior.
- Reference the layer model: `web/`, `api/`, `agents/`, `utils/apps/`, `utils/shared/`.
- Keep platform docs synchronized in `docs/platform.md` (architecture, routes, components, deployment, testing).
- Keep API docs synchronized in `docs/api.md`.
